title: Monsoon Session begins today: Govt, Oppn brace for showdown over Ram Mandir donation, NEET protests, CJP march
description: The Monsoon Session of Parliament will convene on July 20, Monday, with the Centre and the Opposition set to lock horns on several issues, while Nationalist Citizens Party of India (NCPI) will make its debut with 20 rebel MPs from Trinamool Congress.
